items.question: What is SmartResto?
items.answer: SmartResto brings together two proven solutions: an online ordering site and a platform for inventory, suppliers, purchases and accounting for restaurants.

items.question: Do I need to adopt both solutions?
items.answer: No. Each solution works independently. You can start with one and add the other when you're ready.

items.question: Is there a commission on orders?
items.answer: No. Unlike marketplaces, SmartResto online ordering takes no commission per order.

items.question: Does SmartResto handle multiple branches?
items.answer: Yes. The management platform offers a consolidated view as well as detailed tracking per location.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Request a free demo. Our team sets up your environment and guides you every step of the way.
